title: reporting.ops_alert.raised.v1
description: An alert of the owner's live operations board became active (ADM-042, LiveOpsService.evaluate): a doctor running late, the pharmacy wait over its target, or booking requests waiting too long. Raised once per alert while it stays active, and only for a clinic that has a live board open; subject = the doctor for doctor_late, else the clinic. A code and a severity only: the board re-reads GET /v1/reports/live. Consumer core.realtime (SseFanoutConsumer: ops topic).

code.description: lab_tat_breach is reserved: nothing raises it until lab orders exist.

version.description: Outbox id of this event: monotonic per aggregate.
